note: What the readers of a kind file a person adds answer (docs/03 ADR-39; docs/02 T-T25): the website (`web/src/app/core/user-kinds/user-kind-file.ts`, `user-kind-file.spec.ts`), the phones (`:shared` `UserKindFiles`, `UserKindVectorsTest`, the second pull request) and the server (`KindFiles.parse`, `UserKindVectorsTest`: the server stores no such kind, so it holds only the `base` column, that its reader of built-in files refuses what `base` says and takes the rest). `valid` are accepted by every reader and by `user-kind.schema.json` (with `kind.schema.json`), and resolve to `resolved` (the `search` a list reads: the file's own, then every typed extra it does not name; the capabilities as `capabilitiesOf` gives them). Each `invalid` case is one fault in an otherwise valid file: `code` and `path` are the first fault the apps' readers report; `schema` says whether the schema alone refuses it (null: there is no parsed document to give it), `base` whether the server's reader of built-in kind files does. A case is `json` (the text as it is), `generate` (`prefix`, then `repeat` written `times` times, then `suffix`) or `patch` (the valid file named `base`, with `set` [path, value] and `remove` [path] applied in order, a path a list of keys and indexes; then `manyExtras` n: the extras replaced by n text extras `x1`..`xn` {type text, maxLength 10, section details, order i, label {text "Field i"}}; `manyOptions` {extra, count}: that extra's options replaced by `count` options `O1`.. with labels "Option i"; `manyEnums` {count, options}: the extras replaced by `count` enum extras `e1`.. each with `options` options; `manyChecks` n: the checklist replaced by n items `c1`.. "Check i"), written back with no spaces. Expected values are written by hand from the rules, never computed by a reader.
